rules.statement: A buyer's refusal to pay for delivered goods, indicating an intention not to be bound by the contract terms, can constitute a repudiation of the agreement.
rules.supporting_quote: 'In regard to the 200 cases purchased by the respondent to which he refers in P 11 dated September 29, it is true that he had not then told the appellant in so many words that he would not pay for the instalments till delivery had been made in full, but it is obvious that that was what he had intended to convey.'
